sloka: तम् मुक्त कण्ठम्  उत्क्षिप्य शङ्कु कर्णम् महास्वनम् ।विराधम् प्राक्षिपत् श्वभ्रे नदन्तम् भैरव स्वनम् ॥३-४-२८॥
transliteration: tam mukta kaṇṭham  utkṣipya śaṅku karṇam mahāsvanam ।virādham prākṣipat śvabhre nadantam bhairava svanam ॥3-4-28॥

translations.english: Rama and Lakshmana, stable and firm, brave and quick, together lifted the body of Viradha who was fierce in battle and roaring and forcibly threw it into the pit with joy.
